hero.headline: Show up to play. Walk away having fed a family.
hero.subhead: Karma turns pickup soccer, basketball and community runs you'd play anyway into food, funds and support for local foster homes.
hero.imageAlt: Photo slot: players mid-game, arms raised

premise.lead: A game is just a game — until forty people show up for it.
premise.body: Every pickup match is a reason to gather. We turn that gathering into cans of food on a table, dollars in a jar, and points on a board. You get the run, the rivalry, the post-game high-fives. A foster home nearby gets dinner.

howItWorks.heading: Three steps between you and your first assist off the field.

steps.title: Join Karma
steps.description: Sign up in a few minutes. Pick the sports and neighborhoods you actually want to show up for.

steps.title: Show up and get scanned in
steps.description: Bring canned goods, gear or a few dollars. Scan in at the event and it's logged automatically.

steps.title: Earn points
steps.description: Every appearance and every donation adds to your season total — and to what your community delivers.

impact.heading: Numbers we're proud of — and racing to beat.
impact.note: Placeholder figures. Real, live numbers ship in Release 4.

points.heading: Friendly competition. Real stakes for real kids.
points.body: Every game you attend and every donation you bring earns points on the season leaderboard. Climb it because you love winning — and because the higher it goes, the more foster homes get fed.
points.prizeDetail: The member with the most points when the year ends takes it home.

events.heading: Pick a game. Show up. Bring something.

closing.heading: Your next pickup game could feed a family this week.
closing.subhead: It costs nothing but the game you were already going to play.
